title: Modern Luxury Living Room
overview: A complete bespoke transformation of a spacious living pavilion featuring fluted charcoal louvers, custom Italian marble TV backdrop, warm recessed 48V magnetic track lighting, and CenturyPly Club Prime cabinetry.
challenge: The space had uneven natural lighting and exposed columns that interrupted sightlines. The client desired a grand hotel-suite ambience with low-maintenance materials.
solution: We concealed the structural columns behind acoustic wood-fluted panelling with integrated bronze LED channels and installed seamless marble acrylics with concealed Häfele hardware.

testimonial.quote: Shree Shyam Interior transformed our raw house into a magazine-worthy haven. The attention to detail in the fluted wood and lighting is exceptional.
testimonial.author: Er. Rajeshwar Sharma

title: Minimalist High-Gloss Modular Kitchen
overview: German-standard ergonomic kitchen with anti-fingerprint charcoal acrylic finishes, quartz countertop, Häfele Matrix Box drawer runners, and touch sensor LED cabinet lighting.
challenge: Maximum storage was required for Indian spice jars, heavy cookware, and dedicated appliance garages without cluttering the island counter.
solution: Custom tall pantry unit with dual soft-closing pullouts, blind corner magic carousels, and 100% boiling waterproof marine plywood fabrication.

testimonial.quote: Working in this kitchen is pure joy. Every drawer glides effortlessly, and the surface wipes clean with a damp cloth in seconds.
testimonial.author: Dr. Sunita Singhal

title: Corporate Law Chambers & Suite
overview: Prestigious executive corporate chambers designed with dark walnut fluted acoustics, slim aluminium glass partitions, conference automation, and bespoke credenzas.
challenge: Client needed strict soundproofing (STC 45+) between client consultation rooms while maintaining an open, sunlit contemporary aesthetic.
solution: Engineered double-glazed Saint-Gobain acoustic acoustic glass with concealed drop seals and acoustic wall paneling calibrated for speech clarity.

testimonial.quote: The acoustic privacy and dignified elegance achieved by the Shree Shyam team exceeded all partner expectations. Truly world class.
testimonial.author: Adv. Vikramjit Singh

title: Royal Heritage Master Bedroom Suite
overview: A warm blend of Rajasthani architectural motifs with Italian minimalism: handcrafted jali lattice backlit with 3000K warm LEDs, fluted velvet headboard, and floor-to-ceiling tinted glass walk-in wardrobe.
challenge: Balancing heritage Rajput craftsmanship with contemporary sleek lines and modern smart lighting automation.
solution: CNC-routed teak wood jali panels framed in brushed champagne gold aluminium, paired with silent soft-close sliding wardrobe systems.

testimonial.quote: They blended our traditional Rajasthani roots with sleek modern storage in the most breathtaking way imaginable.
testimonial.author: Meenakshi Shekhawat

title: Designer Jewelry & Textile Boutique
overview: High-security commercial renovation with custom velvet display vitrines, ultra-clear low-iron anti-reflective glass, and custom fluted copper ceiling canopies.
challenge: Renovation had to be executed without shutting down adjacent operations, adhering to strict dust barriers and rapid structural turnaround.
solution: Off-site CNC prefabrication at our Sikar workshop followed by precision overnight on-site installation within 14 working days.

testimonial.quote: Customer footfall and compliments have soared since reopening. The lighting and display finishes are flawless.
testimonial.author: Anand Soni

title: Heritage Duplex Villa Complete Turnkey
overview: Comprehensive civil and turnkey interior overhaul of a 25-year-old traditional residence into a modern, energy-efficient luxury sanctuary with home theatre and rooftop lounge.
challenge: Damp walls, outdated plumbing lines, and uneven floor levels needed complete structural remediation before interior fit-outs.
solution: Dr. Fixit waterproofing injected structural repair, followed by lightweight gypsum ceilings, engineered wooden flooring, and centralized smart switches.

testimonial.quote: From tearing down old walls to the final coat of Italian polish, Shree Shyam Interior managed everything under one roof with total integrity.
testimonial.author: Col. R. S. Choudhary
